cuts.note: Each small graph is exhaustively checked. These finite graphs do not establish an asymptotic expander family.

large_symmetric_rigidity.certified_statement: No symmetric core of rank below 6, with arbitrary diagonal, has this observed off-diagonal matrix within 4n unordered edge changes.
large_symmetric_rigidity.method: Exact codeword distances and support-cover inequality; not enumeration of all competing matrices.
large_symmetric_rigidity.limitation: The union of random cycles here is not certified as an expander. It is used only for the sparse-corruption/rank-rigidity certificate.
